services.value: Provides environmental laboratory services including "Analytical Testing," "Industrial Hygiene" and "Material & Product Testing," plus field services such as "Water Quality Monitoring," "Soil & Sludge Sampling," "Industrial Hygiene Sampling," "Waste Stream Sampling," and "Air Analysis." Also lists water (including Legionella/coliform/E. coli/metals), wastewater analyses, compliance testing (e.g., SPDES/DMR sampling and wastewater compositors), and air sampling (e.g., asbestos/mold sampling and passive badge sampling).
